names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 6 februarie, «Sfântul Mucenic Iulian». The life the site prints for him is headed «Viața Sfântului Mucenic Iulian din Emesa».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 6 Φεβρουαρίου, «Άγιος Ιουλιανός ὁ ἐν Ἐμέσῃ», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 6 февраля ст. ст., «Иулиан Эмесский (Емисский), мч.», with the rank word and the office left off. The link prints «(Емисский)» as a variant of the epithet, which is the spelling the day's own line uses; the head form is the one taken here.

death.note: doxologia.ro's life: «Sfântul Mucenic Iulian era originar din orașul fenician Emesa și a suferit în anul 312 sub împăratul Maximian.»

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 6 февраля ст. ст. — «Мч. Иулиана Емисского (312).»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 6 februarie — «Sfântul Mucenic Iulian»

attestations.note: The site prints no troparion for him.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 6ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Άγιος Ιουλιανός ὁ ἐν Ἐμέσῃ»
